name: Itsu made mo Musuko no Mama ja Irarenai! 2 ~Kyonyuu Kyoushi no Kaa-san ni Ie Demo Gakuen Demo Amaetai! Aa, Ii yo Kaa-san! Haa Haa, Sugoku Koufun Suru!~
original_name: いつまでも息子のままじゃいられない！2 ～巨乳教師の母さんに家でも学園でも甘えたい！ ああっ、いいよ母さんっ！ はぁはぁ、すごく昂奮するっ！～
source:
The protagonist, Ren, is an honor student, who is strictly educated by his mother and trying to succeed his father, who is a doctor.
He respects his mother a lot, but sometimes, he just wants her to be a little bit more lenient.

One day, he accidently sees his mother masturbating.
After that, when studying with her, he keeps thinking of it and gets excited.
Even though he is ready to be scolded, she calmly chided:
"So this is why you can't concentrate."
And promptly help him get off.

From then on, in other to help him focus, she decides to help him relief every study session...

[Translated from [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc2/pcl016/musumama2.html#story]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
主角任是一名优等生，他受到母亲的严格教育，并试图继承身为医生的父亲。
他很尊重他的母亲，但有时，他只是希望她能宽容一点。

有一天，他无意中看到母亲自慰。
此后，和她一起学习时，他总是想起这件事，兴奋不已。
尽管他已经做好了挨骂的准备，她却平静地斥道：
“所以这就是你无法集中注意力的原因。”
并及时扶他下车。

从此，为了帮助他集中注意力，她决定帮他缓解每次学习的压力……

[翻译自[url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc2/pcl016/musumama2.html#story]官方网站[/url]]
